title: Hand-held fabric fiber component nondestructive cleaning analyzer and method

pse.problem: Limitation in data integration and centralization due to confidentiality and cost issues, data isolation problem, data privacy concerns, risk of data leakage during conventional data transmission, monopoly of a data center company, and heavy load on a central server caused by huge data scale in federated learning.
pse.solution_function: A portable hand-held fabric fiber component nondestructive cleaning analyzer based on federated learning is designed to address the problems of data safety and data privacy in the market. The instrument performs local storage of training data, uploading of model parameters instead of complete training data, protecting data privacy by eliminating the need for data collection in advance, and applying federated learning to textile component detection.
pse.solution_structure: The analyzer includes a power module (input interface, voltage converter, safety valve, battery), and a processing unit (processor, memory). The processing unit controls the overall operation of the analyzer and communicates with other participants for federated learning.
pse.solution_implementation: The analyzer operates by collecting fabric data from various sources, preprocessing the data locally to extract features, training a deep learning model on these features using federated learning, and making predictions about the fabric composition. The learning parameters are shared with other participants for collective model updates without sharing raw data.
pse.effect: The proposed solution offers benefits such as improved data privacy protection, reduction in data transmission risks, alleviation of central server load, portability, ease of operation, low environmental requirements, efficiency, quick processing, and cost-effectiveness.
